Where to stay in Florence

Every area rated for day and night, with the reasoning and the sources behind each rating.

🟡 Local-source safety assessment · 74 areas reviewed individually Methodology →

For a short stay in Florence: Centro Storico (Duomo, Signoria), Boboli (Giardino di Boboli) and Santo Spirito (Oltrarno). One area for each kind of trip, each shown with its own day and night rating — including where that rating says be careful. None of them is here because someone paid for it.

Calm — no particular concern
Caution — fine by day, be more careful in the evening/night
Not recommended for a tourist — known, recurring issues
Dashed outline: no area-specific findings
